designs.headline: Sərhədlə 122 min token 20 minə düşdü
designs.scene: A wide cascade of molten chrome pours from above but hits a narrow slotted gate fixed in the lower third of the frame. Most of the metal mass piles up, overflowing uselessly around the gate's edges, thick and chaotic. Through the gate's single narrow slit, only a thin, controlled yellow stream passes clean and bright, falling into a small polished glass vessel below. The vessel holds just a modest pool of yellow liquid, precise and contained, contrasting with the sprawling excess above the gate. Composition stays low: gate, overflow, and vessel occupy the bottom 60%, while the upper third remains empty ivory space. Sharp material contrast between dull chrome excess and the single clean yellow thread defines the tension.
designs.metaphor: Geniş axının dar qapıdan süzülməsi kimi, axtarışa qoyulan sərhəd də lazımsız yükü kənarda qoyub yalnız dəqiq nəticəni keçirir.

designs.headline: Sərhədli axtarış, aydın cavab
designs.scene: A towering chrome horn dominates the frame, its wide flared mouth beginning just below the top third and sweeping outward to fill the full width of the composition. The polished metal surface catches sharp reflections as the horn curves and narrows continuously downward, its walls converging with mechanical precision. Near the bottom, the chrome collapses into a slender transparent glass throat, through which a single bright yellow filament of light threads cleanly downward, exiting the frame's lower edge still thin and unbroken. No pooling, no excess spills outside the horn's form; the entire tension lives in the smooth transition from vast chrome mouth to narrow glass channel. The sculpture spans most of the frame's height, dense and continuous, while the upper space above the horn's mouth stays empty ivory.
designs.metaphor: Genişlənmiş xrom buynuzun şüşə boğazda tək sarı zolağa sıxılması kimi, axtarışa qoyulan sərhəd də səs-küyü kənarda qoyub yalnız dəqiq nəticəni keçirir.

designs.headline: Mərkəz 5G-dən AI çipinə keçdi
designs.scene: A massive chrome ring, thick and flawlessly polished, stands upright and fills most of the frame's height, its circular form beginning just below the top third and extending nearly to the bottom edge. Inside the ring's hollow core, a large yellow glass sphere sits off-center, swollen and luminous, pulling the entire structure into a visible tilt as if its gravity has shifted inward. On the lighter side the chrome arcs thin and strained, catching sharp cold reflections, while the glass-heavy side presses downward with dense glowing weight, nearly touching the ring's inner wall. The sculpture's old balance point, once centered, has clearly migrated toward this radiant yellow mass. The background stays empty ivory, isolating the tilted ring as the single, unmistakable focus.
designs.metaphor: Xrom halqanın içindəki sarı şüşə nüvənin bir tərəfə əyilib ağırlıq mərkəzini dəyişməsi kimi, patent dəyəri də 5G şəbəkəsindən AI hesablama çiplərinə keçib.
